items.title: A low-cost tool can help people plan successful evacuation routes during a tsunami
items.summary: People living in coastal communities sometimes have only minutes to reach a safe spot after an earthquake-triggered tsunami. But will the evacuation route that they've chosen lead them to safety?

items.title: Growing up poor does not automatically shape how politicians understand inequality, study finds
items.summary: A politician who grew up in poverty might be expected to see inequality differently from someone raised in comfort. But a new study finds that personal experience does not speak for itself: what matters is how politicians interpret the struggles they lived through.

items.summary: The secret to aging more slowly may be hiding in your gut. items.title: Q&A: Is AI making it harder to learn? What a former executive wants every student to know
items.summary: When Miriam Friedel started working at Capital One in 2020, generative AI was still largely a research curiosity. By the time she left the company as vice president of machine learning engineering in 2026, AI tools were writing code, building applications and reshaping how people work.

items.title: Low testosterone may make sugar far more harmful to your liver
items.summary: Scientists have discovered that low testosterone and a high-fructose diet can work together to worsen fatty liver disease in mice. Unexpectedly, changes in gut bacteria appear to drive this harmful interaction, revealing a potential new target for preventing liver damage.

items.title: El Niño watch: The impacts around the world this week
items.summary: The effects of El Niño are being felt globally, ranging from floods in Argentina to deadly fires in Peru and drought in French Guiana, and prompting a U.N. call for speedy action to face an unprecedented "wrecking ball" this year.

items.title: India orders evacuations as Cyclone Arnab looms
items.summary: Indian authorities ordered nearly 100,000 people to evacuate homes in Andhra Pradesh and Odisha ahead of a severe cyclone the national weather office expects to make landfall by Wednesday.
